generatedBy: tools/generate_llm_benchmark.py from the LLM benchmark run's computed results file (workspace/nppad_llm_bench/llm_benchmark_results.json). No number is typed into the page.

method.serialization: All 6 samples of each channel, in time order, rounded to 3 significant figures, one labeled row per channel. One identical zero shot prompt for every model.
method.parsing: Strict: an answer counts only if it is exactly one class code after trimming. Anything else is a parse failure and scores as wrong.

models.name: Claude
models.access: Blinded subagent calls: each call received only the prompt text for a batch of up to 6 windows, keyed by window ID, with no labels or study context.
models.latencyNote: wall clock for 16 parallel blinded batch calls

models.name: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct
models.access: Local llama.cpp (build b12032) server, temperature 0, seed 2026, 16 max tokens.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.access: Local llama.cpp (build b12032) server, temperature 0, seed 2026, 16 max tokens.

trainedReferences.note: Trained models from the NPPAD study, full test split. Not evaluated on the 48 window LLM sample. Values recomputed from the study's per window artifacts by verify_references.py (CNN and GRU at t0 = 100 exist only as aggregate grid values, cross checked between HW2_Combined_Results_All_Models.csv and the twin's data/results.json).

notRun.ChatGPT: Not run: the key authenticates, but the OpenAI account has no API credits remaining. Every chat completion call returned HTTP 429 (no credits), so no ChatGPT answers could be collected.
notRun.Gemini: Not completed: the provided Gemini key is on the Free Tier, which allows 20 generate requests per day per model (the API quoted a retry delay of about 12.5 hours), so the 96 window protocol cannot be served today. The Pro models were also unusable on this key: gemini-2.5-pro is no longer available to new users, and gemini-3.1-pro-preview was already quota exhausted. About 30 genuine answers from gemini-3-flash-preview are preserved in the working folder (gemini_partial_3flash_outputs.csv), but they cover only part of the sample, so no Gemini score is claimed. A paid tier key, or the daily quota reset, completes this row under the same protocol.
